comment: The jerkin, a DYEABLE commoner garment: one shell per covered limb, each of which becomes a real rig slot on the wearer and therefore burns, dissolves, carves, severs and drops exactly as a limb does. The art is a GREYSCALE WEAVE — every cell is a multiplier on the wearer's dye (game/dye.h), not a colour — so one pattern covers every colour anybody picks. Geometry is the stock human's own silhouette dilated outward by one authored micro. Regenerate with scripts/gen_peasant_clothes.py; `offset` and `fitBox` are MEASURED off gen_human.py's limb table, so editing them by hand puts the garment off the body.
name: jerkin
